"Build a clean, modern, single-file HTML5 web application (`index.html`) that acts as a general-purpose AI Image Generator and Image Studio with no login, no token system, and no API key required.

### 1. Text-to-Image @COMMENT_BODY@ Image-to-Image (Img2Img) Engine:
- **Text-to-Image Generation:** Connect directly to a free, keyless client-side image generation endpoint (`https://pollinations.ai{encodedPrompt}?width={w}@COMMENT_BODY@height={h}@COMMENT_BODY@seed={randomSeed}@COMMENT_BODY@nologo=true`) so images generate directly in the browser from any text prompt.
- **Import @COMMENT_BODY@ Remix Mode (Image-to-Image):**
  - Include an **\"Import Image\"** button (`<input type=\"file\" accept=\"image/*\">`) plus drag-and-drop support so the user can load any photo, sketch, or picture from their phone or PC onto the main HTML5 `<canvas>`.
  - Allow the user to either edit the imported image directly on the canvas OR send a hosted/public image URL + prompt to the Img2Img parameter (`@COMMENT_BODY@image={encodedImageUrl}`) to restyle or transform an image using AI.

### 2. Built-In Client-Side Image Studio (Works 100% Offline on Imported @COMMENT_BODY@ Generated Images):
- Render all generated and imported images onto an interactive HTML5 `<canvas>` with real-time adjustment sliders that work offline:
  - **Visual Filters:** Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Hue Rotate, Blur, and Invert.
  - **Quick Crop / Aspect Ratio Fit:** Fit or crop any imported image cleanly to **Square (1:1)**, **Landscape (16:9)**, or **Portrait (9:16)**.
  - **Overlay Text / Meme / Title Tool:** Optional input box to stamp custom styled text onto the top or bottom of the image.

### 3. Clean Studio Interface (Responsive for Mobile @COMMENT_BODY@ Desktop):
- **Prompt @COMMENT_BODY@ Controls:** A large text box for typing any image prompt, a **\"Generate\"** button, an **\"Import Photo\"** button, and a **\"Reset Edits\"** button.
- **Seed @COMMENT_BODY@ Style Pills:** Automatic random seed per generation (with a lock-seed toggle) and quick-tap style pills (`Photorealistic`, `3D Render`, `Digital Art`, `Cyberpunk`, `Anime`, `Cinematic Lighting`, `4K Detailed`).
- **Session Gallery @COMMENT_BODY@ One-Click Export:**
  - Display the active canvas large and centered with a **\"Download PNG\"** button that exports the final image (including any applied filters or text overlays).
  - Keep a scrollable session history bar at the bottom storing thumbnails of both generated and imported images so the user can switch between them anytime.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

}

button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer}

.app{position:relative;z-index:1;height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column}

}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:0}

.brand-word{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1}

.brand-word b span{color:var(--acid);font-style:italic}
.brand-word small{margin-top:4px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.top-center{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;

.top-center .pulse-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acid);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(217,255,98,.09);animation:pulse 3s infinite}

.btn{

}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--line-hi);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn svg{width:14px;height:14px;flex:0 0 auto}
.btn.primary{background:var(--acid);border-color:var(--acid);color:#15170c;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(217,255,98,.13)}

.btn.icon{width:39px;padding:0}

.workspace{
  flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:326px minmax(360px,1fr) 306px;
  gap:0;
  padding:16px 18px 18px;
  position:relative;
}
.panel{
  min-height:0;background:rgba(19,19,22,.84);

  overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.composer{margin-right:9px}
.adjuster{margin-left:9px}
.panel-scroll{overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;flex:1;min-height:0;padding:19px 18px 18px}
.panel-head{
  flex:0 0 auto;padding:17px 18px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;
}
.eyebrow{

.eyebrow b{color:var(--text);font-weight:500}

}

/* Composer */
.composer .panel-scroll{padding-top:4px}
.prompt-shell{

  transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;
}
.prompt-shell:focus-within{border-color:rgba(217,255,98,.4);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(217,255,98,.045)}
.prompt-shell.shake{animation:shake .38s}
@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(-5px)}40%{transform:translateX(4px)}60%{transform:translateX(-3px)}80%{transform:translateX(2px)}}
.prompt-label{
  position:absolute;top:12px;left:13px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.2em;
  color:var(--muted-2);text-transform:uppercase;pointer-events:none;

#prompt{

.prompt-foot{

  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;

}
.prompt-foot .kbd-hint{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.kbd{font-family:var(--mono);padding:2px 5px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);font-size:7px;color:#888781}

.control-label{

}

.style-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.style-chip{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:28px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:100px;

}
.style-chip:hover{border-color:var(--line-hi);color:var(--text)}
.style-chip .chip-check{width:9px;height:9px;opacity:0;transform:scale(.5);transition:.16s;flex:0 0 auto}
.style-chip.active{border-color:rgba(217,255,98,.42);background:rgba(217,255,98,.09);color:var(--acid)}
.style-chip.active .chip-check{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
.style-hint{margin-top:8px;font-size:9px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted-2)}

.seed-card{

}
.seed-main{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}

}
.seed-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);color:var(--text)}

.seed-btn svg{width:13px;height:13px}

}

.optional{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:6px;letter-spacing:.11em;color:var(--muted-2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:2px 5px;border-radius:100px;text-transform:uppercase}
.chev{width:12px;height:12px;color:var(--muted);transition:transform .2s}
.remix-card[open] .chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.remix-body{padding:0 12px 12px}
.remix-body p{margin:0 0 9px;font-size:9px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted)}
.url-row{display:flex;gap:5px}
.url-row input{
  min-width:0;flex:1;height:32px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:#0a0a0c;outline:none;font-size:9px;color:#d8d4cc;
}
.url-row input::placeholder{color:#51504c}
.url-row input:focus{border-color:rgba(217,255,98,.32)}
.url-clear{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.url-clear:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--line-hi)}
.url-clear svg{width:11px;height:11px}
.remix-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-top:7px}

.url-load svg{width:11px;height:11px}
.remix-state{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted-2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;max-width:160px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.remix-state.active{color:var(--acid)}
.remix-state .dot{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}

.generate-btn{
  position:relative;width:100%;height:50px;margin-top:15px;border-radius:11px;

}

.generate-btn .gen-shine{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:70px;left:-90px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.42),transparent);transform:skewX(-20deg);animation:shine 4.8s ease-in-out infinite}

.action-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin-top:7px}

.action-pair .btn:hover{color:var(--text)}
.privacy-note{margin-top:12px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;font-size:8px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted-2)}
.privacy-note svg{width:11px;height:11px;flex:0 0 auto;margin-top:.5px;color:#71706b}

  min-width:0;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;

}
.stage-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.stage-title b{color:#d8d4cc;font-weight:500}
.stage-title .slash{color:#45444a}
.type-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:4px;

}
.type-badge.gen{border-color:rgba(217,255,98,.24);background:rgba(217,255,98,.07);color:#cfe875}
.type-badge.import{border-color:rgba(255,122,92,.24);background:rgba(255,122,92,.07);color:#ff9b83}
.canvas-meta{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;color:#77766f;letter-spacing:.04em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.canvas-meta .meta-dot{width:3px;height:3px;background:#4f4e49;border-radius:50%}

.canvas-stage{
  flex:1;min-height:0;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:12px;padding:16px 22px 12px;
}

}
.stage-caption .live-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acid);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(217,255,98,.4);flex:0 0 auto}
.stage-caption b{color:#aaa7a0;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.stage-caption .caption-sep{color:#39383c}
.stage-caption .drag-hint{color:#55544f;font-size:8px}

/* Canvas overlays */
.loading-overlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:8;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:16px;padding:24px;border-radius:4px;text-align:center;

  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .25s,visibility .25s;
}
.loading-overlay.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.loader-orbit{width:64px;height:64px;position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center}
.loader-orbit::before,.loader-orbit::after{content:"";position:absolute;border-radius:50%}
.loader-orbit::before{inset:0;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);border-top-color:var(--acid);animation:spin 1.5s linear infinite}
.loader-orbit::after{inset:9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-bottom-color:var(--coral);animation:spin 2.2s linear infinite reverse}
.loader-core{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%,#f7ffd2,var(--acid) 36%,#6c8428);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(217,255,98,.35);animation:breathe 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes breathe{0%,100%{transform:scale(.9);opacity:.8}50%{transform:scale(1.05);opacity:1}}
.loading-copy{width:min(280px,100%)}
.loading-copy .eyebrow{justify-content:center;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:7px;color:var(--acid)}
.loading-copy h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:25px;letter-spacing:-.3px;margin:0 0 3px;line-height:1.1}
.loading-copy p{margin:0;font-size:9px;color:#8c8984;line-height:1.5;min-height:27px}
.progress-track{height:2px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);overflow:hidden;margin-top:13px}
.progress-track span{display:block;height:100%;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--coral),var(--acid));transition:width .6s ease}
.loading-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#66655f}
.loading-meta button{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#aaa79f;padding:3px 0;text-transform:uppercase}
.loading-meta button:hover{color:var(--coral)}
.drop-overlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:9;border-radius:4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
  background:rgba(11,12,8,.84);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border:1px dashed rgba(217,255,98,.65);
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.18s;pointer-events:none;
}
.drop-overlay.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.drop-overlay svg{width:30px;height:30px;color:var(--acid)}
.drop-overlay b{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;font-weight:400}
.drop-overlay span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}

/* Gallery */
.gallery-section{
  flex:0 0 auto;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(10,10,12,.55);
  padding:10px 13px 12px;position:relative;z-index:2;
}
.gallery-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;padding:0 2px}
.gallery-head .eyebrow{font-size:7px}
.gallery-head .gallery-count{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--muted-2)}
.gallery{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;padding:2px 2px 4px;min-height:76px;scroll-behavior:smooth}
.gallery-empty{

.gallery-item{

.gallery-thumb{
  width:88px;height:62px;border-radius:7px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  position:relative;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);overflow:hidden;transition:.18s;
}
.gallery-thumb::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04);background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 55%,rgba(0,0,0,.32))}
.gallery-item:hover .gallery-thumb{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.gallery-item.active .gallery-thumb{border-color:var(--acid);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(217,255,98,.18)}
.gallery-item.active .gallery-label{color:var(--acid)}
.gallery-kind{
  position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;z-index:2;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:5px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);background:rgba(0,0,0,.52);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  border-radius:3px;padding:2px 3px;backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
}
.gallery-item.active .gallery-thumb::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;right:5px;bottom:5px;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;

.gallery-label{font-size:8px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;color:#8d8b85;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;padding:0 1px;transition:color .18s}
.gallery-sub{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:6px;color:#565550;letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;padding:0 1px}

/* Adjuster */
.adjuster .panel-scroll{padding-top:1px}
.adjuster-section{padding-bottom:16px;margin-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.052)}
.adjuster-section:last-of-type{border-bottom:0;margin-bottom:8px;padding-bottom:5px}
.section-title{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px}
.section-title .eyebrow{font-size:8px}
.section-title .mini-value{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;color:var(--muted-2)}
.filter-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.filter-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px 1fr 39px;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.filter-row label{font-size:9px;color:#aaa7a0;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.filter-row output{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;color:#8a8882;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.02em}
input[type=range]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:16px;background:transparent;outline:none;margin:0;cursor:pointer;
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:2px;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--acid) 0%,var(--acid) var(--pct,50%),rgba(255,255,255,.12) var(--pct,50%))}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-track{height:2px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-progress{height:2px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--acid)}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#f2f0e9;margin-top:-4px;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #141416,0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.2);transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover{transform:scale(1.18);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #141416,0 0 0 3px var(--acid)}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{width:10px;height:10px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#f2f0e9;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #141416,0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
input[type=range].active::-webkit-slider-thumb{background:var(--acid);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #141416,0 0 0 3px rgba(217,255,98,.5)}

.ratio-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px}
.ratio-btn{
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.018);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 4px 7px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;color:#8d8b84;transition:.18s;
}
.ratio-btn:hover{border-color:var(--line-hi);color:var(--text)}
.ratio-btn.active{border-color:rgba(217,255,98,.38);background:rgba(217,255,98,.07);color:var(--acid)}
.ratio-icon{display:block;border:1.5px solid currentColor;border-radius:2px;opacity:.8}
.ratio-btn[data-ratio="1:1"] .ratio-icon{width:15px;height:15px}
.ratio-btn[data-ratio="16:9"] .ratio-icon{width:20px;height:11px}
.ratio-btn[data-ratio="9:16"] .ratio-icon{width:11px;height:20px}
.ratio-btn b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em}
.ratio-btn span{font-size:6px;color:#5f5e59;letter-spacing:.02em}
.ratio-btn.active span{color:#a5b773}
.segmented{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;background:#0d0d0f;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:3px;border-radius:8px;gap:3px;margin-top:7px}
.segmented button{height:25px;border-radius:5px;font-size:8px;font-weight:600;color:#77756f;transition:.18s}
.segmented button:hover{color:#b8b5ae}
.segmented button.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#e4e1da;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}

.switch-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:9px}
.switch-row>span{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;color:#aaa7a0}
.switch{position:relative;display:inline-flex;width:30px;height:17px;flex:0 0 auto}
.switch input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;cursor:pointer;z-index:2}
.switch-track{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:100px;background:#29292e;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);transition:.2s;position:relative}
.switch-track::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:#8b8983;top:2px;left:2px;transition:.2s}
.switch input:checked + .switch-track{background:rgba(217,255,98,.18);border-color:rgba(217,255,98,.35)}
.switch input:checked + .switch-track::after{transform:translateX(13px);background:var(--acid)}
.text-fields{transition:opacity .2s}
.text-fields.off{opacity:.32;pointer-events:none}
.field-input{
  width:100%;height:32px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:#0d0d0f;outline:none;
  padding:0 9px;font-size:9px;color:#d6d2ca;transition:border-color .2s;
}
.field-input:focus{border-color:rgba(217,255,98,.35)}
.field-input::placeholder{color:#504f4a}
.text-style-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 79px;gap:5px;margin-top:6px}
.mini-select{
  height:32px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:#0d0d0f;color:#b2afa8;
  font-size:8px;padding:0 7px;outline:none;width:100%;appearance:none;
}
.text-pos{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0}
.text-pos button{height:24px;font-size:7px}
.size-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:35px 1fr 32px;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-top:8px}
.size-row span{font-size:8px;color:#77756f}
.size-row output{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;color:#8a8882;text-align:right}

.reset-btn{
  width:100%;height:37px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;color:#8e8b85;
  transition:.2s;margin-top:2px;
}
.reset-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(255,122,92,.3);background:rgba(255,122,92,.055);color:#ff9b83}
.reset-btn svg{width:12px;height:12px}

/* Toast */
.toast{
  position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,18px);z-index:120;
  min-width:180px;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  background:#e8e5dd;color:#151514;border-radius:100px;padding:10px 15px 10px 12px;
  box-shadow:0 14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.42);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.25s;pointer-events:none;
}
.toast.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.toast .toast-icon{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#151514;color:var(--acid);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 auto}
.toast .toast-icon svg{width:10px;height:10px}
.toast.error{background:#ffd8cb}
.toast.error .toast-icon{background:#7b1f0c;color:#ffd8cb}
.toast.success .toast-icon{background:#1e2a08;color:var(--acid)}

.hidden{display:none!important}

@media(max-width:1180px){
  .workspace{grid-template-columns:298px minmax(300px,1fr) 282px;padding:13px 14px 15px}
  .composer{margin-right:7px}.adjuster{margin-left:7px}
  .panel-scroll{padding:16px 14px 15px}
  .panel-head{padding:15px 15px 10px}
  .filter-row{grid-template-columns:57px 1fr 36px;gap:6px}

  .app{height:auto;min-height:100dvh}

  .workspace{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:12px;min-height:0}

  .panel-scroll{overflow:visible}
  .composer .panel-scroll{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 16px}
  .composer .panel-head{grid-column:1/-1}
  .prompt-block{grid-column:1/-1}
  .composer .style-group{grid-column:1/-1}
  .composer .seed-card{margin-top:0}
  .composer .remix-card{margin-top:0}
  .composer .generate-btn{grid-column:1/-1}
  .composer .action-pair{grid-column:1/-1}
  .composer .privacy-note{grid-column:1/-1}
  .adjuster .panel-scroll{display:block}
  .brand-word small{display:none}
  .canvas-stage{padding:15px 16px 9px}
  .canvas-meta{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:650px){
  .topbar{gap:8px}
  .brand-word b{font-size:24px}
  .brand-mark{width:33px;height:33px}
  .btn .btn-label{display:none}
  .top-actions .btn{width:37px;padding:0}
  .top-actions .btn.primary{width:auto;padding:0 13px}
  .workspace{padding:8px;gap:9px}
  .stage{height:calc(100dvh - 72px);min-height:500px;border-radius:16px}
  .stage-top{height:44px;padding:0 12px}
  .stage-caption{font-size:8px;padding:0 5px}
  .stage-caption .drag-hint,.stage-caption .caption-sep{display:none}
  .canvas-stage{padding:13px 12px 8px;gap:8px}
  .gallery-section{padding:8px 10px 10px}
  .gallery-thumb{width:76px;height:54px}
  .gallery-item{flex-basis:76px}
  .gallery{min-height:67px}
  .composer .panel-scroll{display:block}
  .composer .prompt-block{display:block}
  .composer .style-group{margin-top:14px}
  .composer .seed-card{margin-top:13px}
  .composer .remix-card{margin-top:10px}
  .panel{border-radius:16px}
  .panel-head{padding:14px 14px 9px}
  .panel-scroll{padding:13px 14px 15px}
  .toast{bottom:16px}
}
@media(max-height:710px) and (min-width:981px){
  .topbar{height:62px;flex-basis:62px}
  .workspace{padding:11px 14px 12px}
  .panel-head{padding:13px 15px 8px}
  .panel-scroll{padding:11px 14px 12px}
  #prompt{height:98px}
  .style-grid{gap:5px}.style-chip{height:25px;font-size:8px}
  .control-label{margin:13px 0 7px}

  .gallery-thumb{height:51px;width:78px}
  .gallery-item{flex-basis:78px}
  .gallery{min-height:66px}
  .canvas-stage{padding:10px 20px 7px}
}

  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}
}

<div class="app">

        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 16V4"/><path d="m7 9 5-5 5 5"/><path d="M5 20h14"/></svg>
        <span class="btn-label">Import</span>

        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 4v12"/><path d="m7 11 5 5 5-5"/><path d="M5 20h14"/></svg>

  <main class="workspace">
    <aside class="panel composer" aria-label="Prompt and generation controls">

            </button>
            <button class="style-chip" type="button" data-style="Digital Art">
